$comment: Frozen DS15 write-time number profile 'ds15-v1'. Every modelled retained DS15 original (original event and payload, original transition context, first receipt, custody and issued result) was written under it, so retained verification keeps exactly this domain: integers in [-9223372036854775808,18446744073709551615] in the existing shortest canonical MessagePack form, no float (including integral floats such as 1.0), no -0 or leading-zero spelling. ds15IntegerDomain is an asserted custom keyword of the DS15 V1Validator and runs only on those retained originals. Current inputs do not use it: since sweep part 2B numbers they are admitted by CV-1100/SP-1100 (loads_current_json, current_integer at every schema integer slot with the slot's own bounds, storage_uint64 for Storage sequence/generation/offset metadata, storage_value_bytes(EVENT_VALUE) physical bytes, full_value_commitment, qualified JCS with owner-declared integer paths type-sensitive). Since sweep part 2B a retained reader selects this frozen profile only through SP-1101: one selection from Storage's sealed write custody (Plans/ds15_original_custody.json in the static model), then one RetainedDispatcher resolution; the same frozen recipe selects the CV-1101 date-time profiles (the EventRecord profile at every format: date-time, CV-253 storage_utc_z on the Storage-assigned EventRecord observed and persisted times).
